'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Nico Oster DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nico Oster]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
